desc: I build web interfaces and applications where the visual craft matters as much as what happens under the hood. The detail that makes a page pleasant to use interests me as much as the code that runs it.

I first touched web development at 17, back in 2017, tinkering with my early pages. But it was in 2021 that I got serious about it, through intensive training and projects carried all the way through. That's when a passion turned into a real career choice.

Since then I keep learning, on both the dev and design sides, because the field moves fast and that's part of the fun. What drives me is building solutions that genuinely serve the people using them, with clean code and a polished interface.
Day to day, I work with agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) to move faster, from prototype to refactoring, without ever losing control of code quality and architecture.
I'm keen to collaborate on projects that have meaning and ambition. If that's yours, get in touch.

airsen.description: Full-stack air quality monitoring application with interactive map of 35k+ French municipalities, customizable alert system and community forum.

imin.description: Social network mobile app developed at Do&Go. Redesigned the full UI/UX from scratch and implemented it in Flutter. Contributed to Node.js backend testing, missing endpoint coverage and benchmarking infrastructure with AdminJS integration.

homecook.description: A recipe management web application enabling creation, storage and search by categories and ingredients, with user authentication for account and recipe management.

freshmeals.description: A responsive e-commerce site allowing users to browse organic products, select items to purchase, add them to cart, create an account and log in.

healthyfood.description: This project is a replica of the Slimming World website, created as a training project.
